text: MrQ, the Bournemouth sleeve sponsor, is operated by Tek Fox Ltd, a Malta-registered company (C96152); MrQ's own privacy policy names Tek Fox as the data controller, and states Tek Fox Ltd is licensed and regulated in Great Britain by the Gambling Commission under account number 60629. Privately held with no state stake.
